title: OWASP Web Security & Vulnerability Prevention Guidelines
keyTechniques: Sanitize all user inputs and escape HTML characters before rendering dynamic content in DOM to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
Use parameterized SQL queries or ORMs exclusively to prevent SQL Injection (SQLi)
Set secure HTTP response headers (Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) using Helmet.js or server headers
Hash passwords using strong salt algorithms (e.g., bcrypt with cost factor 10+) before persistence
avoid: Never use innerHTML with un-sanitized user input; use textContent or innerText instead
Never store plain-text user passwords in databases or logs
Never trust client-side data validation alone; always enforce server-side validation
